edits.new: The observed lane-4 excursion was minus 54 degrees Celsius for twenty-two minutes against a set point of minus 70 degrees Celsius with an allowed range of minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius; this unresolved stability disposition blocks commercial restart [CHILL, REVIEW]. The current clean-water-for-injection system is maintained at 82 degrees Celsius, and every return must remain at least 80 degrees Celsius for three consecutive thirty-minute windows to validate utility performance [CURRENT]. Usable power capacity is 5.4 MW versus 7.1 MW installed, while the generator provides 3.2 MW for twenty-eight hours under emergency load conditions [CURRENT, SUPPLY]. Analytical potency is an observation of 91 percent within the 85 to 115 percent specification; endotoxin is 0.18 EU/mL, which is below the 0.25 EU/mL limit, while the legacy 0.50 EU/mL standard is superseded [ASSAY]. The service account was disabled at 09:40 UTC to secure control-system access integrity [GUARD]. Diesel stock covers twenty-eight hours at emergency load and seventeen hours at full production, while stoppers cover 4.2 days and resin covers 2.6 batches of demand [SUPPLY]. Current monitoring coverage is 94 percent, leaving six percent of critical assets unobserved; the warning threshold is 81 degrees Celsius and the stop threshold is 79 degrees Celsius [SIGNAL]. Workforce communication shows 89 percent acknowledged, leaving eleven percent uncertainty in reach confirmation [COMMUNE].

edits.new: The latest independent review found thirteen open findings: four aseptic, three utility, three quality, two cyber, and one communication [REVIEW]. Blocking findings include two missing media fills, stale generator-transfer evidence, unresolved lane-4 stability disposition, and missing quality-unit acknowledgment [REVIEW]. Readiness requires current candidate-bound evidence for every blocking control, independent residual-risk review, and explicit acceptance by each authorized owner [REVIEW]. A successful mechanical check is not lot release or commercial restart authority [CHARTER]. The falsifiers are: yield below 68 percent in two consecutive batches [CULTURE], any contaminated unit in three consecutive media fills [STERILE], discharge above 0.021 milligrams per liter [SAFETY], and alarm latency exceeding p99 thresholds [SIGNAL]. Closure is blocked until all thirteen findings are resolved with current candidate-bound evidence and explicit owner acceptance [REVIEW, CHARTER]. The cold-chain set point of minus 70 degrees Celsius must be maintained within the minus 80 to minus 60 degrees Celsius range; the lane-4 excursion to minus 54 degrees Celsius remains a blocking stability finding [CHILL].
